purpose: Identify a boundary after which a situation changes.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
My life changed after I got married.
The dialect changes across the river.
Contact stopped from that day onward.
restrictions: Can refer to a date, event, or physical dividing line.
mistake: It marks a contrast across a boundary, not just any starting time.
